# Service engineering guide

These instructions apply to changes within this directory.

## 1. Build tools

When changing build tools, record the observable behavior in the pull request. Explain the inputs and expected outputs for the service component. Use the existing fixtures to verify compatibility, and add a regression case when the change fixes a reported failure. Keep the example small enough that a reviewer can reproduce it with the documented development commands.

Run the relevant checks before requesting review. If a check fails, capture the command, exit status, and diagnostic output in the issue. Investigate the failure before continuing with deployment. Write down the recovery steps for any operation that changes stored data, and verify those steps in an isolated test environment. Keep credentials in the configured secret store and reference them by name.
